name: Eternal Aspect Diana form change tweak
creator: suriin
description:
## Important info

This will clash with any custom skin that modifies Eternal Aspect Diana + chromas. You must own the skin and choose it in champ select. [3 variants](https://runeforge.dev/mods/ac7224f0-fc12-4d34-8b3d-9464b0098192/releases).

## Description

**Author**: Suriin

**Skin**: Eternal Aspect Diana + chromas

**Affects**: Transformation logic

Makes it so the ult transformation lasts until:
- death
- death or recall
- death with the ability to toggle freely at any time

Go to the [releases tab](https://runeforge.dev/mods/ac7224f0-fc12-4d34-8b3d-9464b0098192/releases) to download the variant you prefer. If you also want the chroma vfx mod go [here](https://runeforge.dev/mods/a1dab040-bc41-499f-8b4d-421f726786a1/releases).
